parole.significato: any Nematocera insect: crane flies, gnats, mosquitoes
parole.testo: Unknown, explained as a doublet of بُرْغُوث (burḡūṯ) from a variant *purḡūś- of Proto-Semitic *purḡūṯ- (“flea”).
